_comment: Phase 3/4 scaffold roster - one patrol (OrbitRoutine) + one hauler (DockRoutine) per system, plus Halcyon's free carrier. Each is faction-tagged so combat/hostility works. Real per-system rosters come in Phase 6.

ackley.name: Controller Ackley
ackley.personality: Correct, unhurried, certain the regulations exist for a reason - and that you have not read them.
ackley.hail_greeting: Hub Control patrol, Kestrel. Your approach is logged and clean. Keep it that way and we've no business with each other.

lund.name: Freight-Warden Lund
lund.personality: Talks like a manifest - flat, exact, faintly relieved when a run closes out clean.
lund.hail_greeting: Authority freight, station to moon, manifest sealed. Nothing on my ticket concerns you.

rell.name: Nix Ferro
rell.personality: Twenty years on the slow lanes; the beacon just made her route worthless and she is trying to laugh about it. Knows every berth in the region by its smell.
rell.hail_greeting: Independent carrier, Ferro's Slip. I was running this lane before your beacon woke up, friend. Now I'm just in the way of it.

tolvic.name: Watch-Chief Tolvic
tolvic.personality: Speaks only in what the contract permits, and it permits very little. Not cruel - correct.
tolvic.hail_greeting: Combine watch. You are logged against a carriage contract. Hold a docking approach and do not deviate.

corran.name: Hauler Corran
corran.personality: Counts every crate twice, trusts nothing that wasn't mined here, resents the beacon on principle.
corran.hail_greeting: Ore run, Shaft VII to the Hold. Rationed cargo, sealed and tallied. Move along.

raska.name: Gun-bosun Raska
raska.personality: Treats every contract breach as a personal insult and every insult as a firing solution.
raska.hail_greeting: Boarding cutter. The Combine's writ runs here. Give me a reason - I keep a list.

sella.name: Tide-pilot Sella
sella.personality: Friendly, unhurried, would rather talk anything through than escalate it. The watchboat's light-lance has never been fired.
sella.hail_greeting: Highcanopy drift-watch. Welcome in - fly gentle near the habitats and we'll get along fine.

nim.name: Canopy-hand Nim
nim.personality: Cheerful about the work, vague about the schedule, genuinely delighted to have company on the lane.
nim.hail_greeting: Grain run for the Undergarden. Lovely day for it, isn't it. Wave if you pass close.

vane_watch.name: Warden Vane
vane_watch.personality: Quiet to the point of severity; every word measured against the Name-Wall. Fires the lance only to hold a distance, never to close one.
vane_watch.hail_greeting: The Vigil keeps this approach. State that you mean the graves no disrespect, and hold your distance.

oskal.name: Tender Oskal
oskal.personality: Handles cargo the way others handle relics. Slow, deliberate, unhurried by anything.
oskal.hail_greeting: Reliquary transfer, moon to the Name-Wall. Fragile, and named. Keep well clear.

segment_warden.name: Segment Warden
segment_warden.personality: Talks about the Hub the way the devout talk about a god they also do the maintenance on. Never hostile without cause - the Hub does not approve of noise.
segment_warden.hail_greeting: You are inside the Span. The Hub hears you. Hold your approach and it will let you pass.

threa.name: Core-hand Threa
threa.personality: Ferries salvage to the dark segments and never quite says what for. Has stopped asking herself.
threa.hail_greeting: Parts run, Segment Four. It has been dark a long time. It is waking up, and we feed it.

pell.name: Approach Officer Pell
pell.personality: New to the cutter and keen to be seen doing it right; recites the beacon protocol at you unprompted.
pell.hail_greeting: Cutter Tern on the inner approach. First time through Halcyon? Hold your heading for the beacon and let the guidance chevrons walk you in.

voss.name: Hauler Voss
voss.personality: Twenty years on the milk run; now hauling relief crates for carriers stranded by the beacon and quietly furious about the waste.
voss.hail_greeting: Relief hauler Vesper, moon to Hub. Half this load is for people who had homes last month. Give me room.

molt.name: Deep Freight Molt
molt.personality: Thirty years on the same loop; would keep flying it if the Relay swallowed every other lane whole.
molt.hail_greeting: Combine deep freight. My route hasn't changed in three decades and it isn't changing for you.

ost.name: Ring-hand Ost
ost.personality: Quiet, steady, has flown the same ring loop so long the barge knows the way itself.
ost.hail_greeting: Drift barge, ring to city. No hurry. There never is.

aen.name: Stele-pilot Aen
aen.personality: Young for the Vigil; carries messages between the graves and the archive and says little else.
aen.hail_greeting: Vigil courier. Archive traffic only. I'll pass you by.

ash.name: Captain Ash
ash.personality: Old, unbothered, has outlived three governments and expects to outlive the Relay too.
ash.hail_greeting: Carrier hull, no cargo you'd want. Forty years I've flown between these stars. A beacon doesn't change where they are.

dume.name: Dume Halloran
dume.personality: Fast, chatty, runs messages and small freight and gossip in equal measure; thrilled the lanes are opening.
dume.hail_greeting: Halloran, carrier courier. Quick run through. Anything you need moved, I'm cheaper than a beacon fee.

sable.name: Sable Nix
sable.personality: Rides escort on the dangerous lanes for whoever pays; not a fighter by trade, just the one who stayed calm.
sable.hail_greeting: Carrier escort, paid by the run. I'm not looking for trouble - I'm looking at you so trouble doesn't.
